sentences.text:
1. This petition has been filed under Section 528 of Bnss for quashing of the impugned Fir No. 342
dated 12.05.2025 under Section 24 of Immigration Act and Section 420 of Ipc registered at Police
Station Barwala District Hisar along with all the consequential proceedings arising therefrom.

2.  Learned counsel for the petitioner contends that the petitioner have preferred a representation/complaint dated 24.06.2025 Annexure P-2 to Additional Director General of Police,
Hisar Division, Hisar but no action has been taken so far.

Learned counsel submits that he would be satisfied if directions are issued to Additional Director General of Police, Hisar Division, Hisar to look into his representation/complaint and take appropriate steps at the earliest.
Notice of motion to the official respondent only.
4. At the asking of the Court, Mr. Rakesh Kumar Jangra, AAG, Haryana accepts notice on behalf of the official respondent.
5. I have heard learned counsel for the parties.

sentences.text: Keeping in view the facts and circumstances of the case and the prayer made by the petitioner, the present petition is disposed of with a direction to Additional Director General of Police, Hisar Division, Hisar to consider and decide the representation/complaint 24.06.2025 Annexure P-2 of the petitioner within a period of four weeks in accordance with law from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order and pass an appropriate order.
